msg: ADR 0028 well-formed kind: ACCEPT the identifier line [a-z][a-z0-9_-]* (shifted-args symptoms like frontend:green stay rc 2), with two refinements: (1) CASE-FOLD before checking — 'Assign' or 'STATUS' is an intent slip, not garbling, so lower-case it, then apply the rules (Assign -> assign, Banana -> note+orig_kind 'banana'); never drop a case slip. (2) LENGTH cap 32: a longer identifier is far more likely a shifted message than a kind, so it is rc 2. Red at 38aa5e4 confirmed here: K1 and K2 fail for the right reasons, K3 and the malformed-args test pass. Add to K: 'Assign' -> stored as assign rc 0; a 33-char identifier -> rc 2.
